method.blind_order: Part A1 answered before Part A2; neither verdicts, pack, verification, audit, audit directory, drafts nor the review note opened before the Part A commit. The privacy check used a two-report temporary index to preserve blinding.
method.source_policy: Fresh direct HTTP sequentially, paced for at least eight seconds per host; the recorded timing exception is disclosed below. Page images read for scan quotations. Search results are discovery only; no Wikipedia evidence used.
method.date_basis: Compare dates attested by the inspected expression, retaining work composition/delivery/publication and later printing separately. A capture timestamp is not the date of historical wording.
limitations: A later edition or transcription is not automatically evidence of identical earlier wording.
A bounded negative search does not establish absence.
No machine agreement is human acceptance.
method.retrieval_coverage: 80 recorded direct HTTP attempts, including a failed initial fetch; response bodies identified by SHA-256. All 14 supplied URLs attempted fresh: 13 preparer hashes match, Butler 1865 differs because the live response is a security page. Recorded starts are at least eight seconds apart per request host except the failed butler-1865-area7-wayback request: 7.994 seconds after the preceding same-host request (6 ms below the requested interval). This is a pacing deviation, not a passage verification. Archive capture times and retrieval times are separate.
method.scope: All 20 Part A prompts, all 15 remaining records, all 8 citation links, and all 8 Part C retrieval tasks addressed (51 report items). Six Part C tasks yielded usable primary witnesses; two remain unavailable. Targeted follow-ups are separate from the frozen blind answers. This is not an exhaustive search of pre-1965 writing. No Russian-cosmist or Soviet-context label was used to infer machine intelligence; only explicit primary-text artificial-thinking claims are eligible.

U01 contest agrees; use the pack’s contrary-only engagement label for this isolated new-statements assertion. The blind reason said it disputed a premise, but the selected passage does not develop the rebuttal. Full-talk U02 evidence belongs in its separate record.
